tiers.name: T0_REUSE
tiers.covers: a result an independent check verified, reused within its validity (E2b); the plan names it

tiers.name: T1_DETERMINISTIC
tiers.covers: an op whose reviewed contract declares it model-free: the same inputs give the same answer

tiers.name: T2_LOW_COST
tiers.covers: an op that may reach a model, whose contract declares a per-call cost at or under low_cost_ceiling

tiers.name: T3_STANDARD
tiers.covers: any other op that may reach a model, its cost declared above low_cost_ceiling or not declared

tiers.name: T4_HIGH_REASONING
tiers.covers: the owner's own chat writes the step: a draft until its check judges it, at a cost G6 is not told

tiers.name: T5_MULTI_WORKER
tiers.covers: a step the owner's chat delegates to children (V4a); the scheduler forms none by itself

tiers.name: T6_SPECIALIST
tiers.covers: a specialist worker: none is formed automatically yet

tiers.name: T7_HUMAN
tiers.covers: a person decides, approves or corrects; never above a mode's ceiling, being the approval itself
